svg.aria-label: A material's route through the engine: the USD file's Material, UsdPreviewSurface and UsdUVTexture are imported into scene::Material and scene::TextureImage, which UsdViewerDemo::Setup uploads through SceneRenderer's AddTexture and AddMaterial as a GpuTexture and a MaterialParameters uniform buffer with set 1. RecordDraws binds set 1 when the material changes, and Mesh.frag.glsl samples it.
